title: THE OPEN MAP HIDES WHAT IS UNDER IT
why: Seen on the map screenshot of 2026-10-07: with the map open, the message under it (Partly cloudy. This will not hold.) still showed through faintly across THE LONG DOCK, because the map backing let six percent of the screen below through. It is near solid now, so only the map shows.
now: Nothing from the HUD shows through the open map any more.

edits.replacement: ctx.fillStyle='rgba(9,12,34,.99)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);   // v16.xx, seen on the map screenshot (2026-10-07): at .94 the message toast under the map ghosted through across THE LONG DOCK; the map now hides what is under it
